sql:
select o.market_ticker, o.event_ticker, o.quantity q, o.limit_price lim, o.status, o.created_at,
 coalesce((select sum(f.quantity) from fills f where f.kalshi_order_id=o.kalshi_order_id),0) filled,
 (select max(p.resolved_value) from paper_trades p where p.market_ticker=o.market_ticker and p.side='no'
    and p.strategy like '%mmsell%' and p.resolved_value is not null) rv
 from live_orders o where o.strategy='Jmmsell10' and o.action='buy' order by o.created_at
